plans.idea: Strong left-aligned editorial column: one tall full-width text block carries headline, intro and steps at large size, with the CTA pill directly under the copy on the same left edge and legal set quietly at the foot.
Symmetric centred poster: copy stack, CTA and legal all share one central vertical axis so the wider 4:5 canvas reads as a balanced, deliberate story card.

Content-plus-footer bar: the text gets nearly the whole canvas for maximum size, and a bottom footer row pairs legal on the left with the CTA anchored bottom-right as the final step of the reading path.
